gemma4-26b.notes: Gemma 4 26B-A4B MoE (4B active). AWQ-4bit ~13GB weights. Smoke-tested gpu_memory_utilization.

gemma4-26b-qat.notes: Gemma 4 26B-A4B MoE (4B active), QAT AWQ-INT4 (compressed-tensors pack-quantized, group_size 32). QAT variant of gemma4-26b — expect better quality at same ~13GB weight footprint.

translategemma-27b.notes: TranslateGemma 27B-it (google/translategemma-27b-it) AutoRound w4a16 — 4-bit, group_size 128, gptq packing (auto_round:auto_gptq), ~17GB weights. Translation-specialised Gemma 3. Registered for KO->EN back-translation comparison vs gemma4-26b-qat. Serve as its own vLLM container on :8087; if quantization=auto-round is unsupported by the installed vLLM, fall back to gptq_marlin. gemma3 multimodal arch — text-only is fine for back-translation.

qwen122b.notes: Qwen 3.5 122B-A10B MoE. Large model, needs most of GPU.

gemma4-31b-remote.notes: LilaRest/gemma-4-31B-it-NVFP4-turbo served via vLLM on LAN. 8192 max_model_len — use style_guide_ko_v3_abbr.md. Set VLLM_BASE_URL=http://192.168.1.76:18000 to target.

gemma4-26b-nvfp4-remote.notes: RedHatAI/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-NVFP4 served via vLLM on LAN. Same base model as local gemma4-26b but NVFP4 quant. 8192 max_model_len — use style_guide_ko_v3_abbr.md.

qwen37-max-remote.notes: Qwen 3.7 Max via Alibaba Model Studio (OpenAI-compatible). Thinking model — set enable_thinking=false in llm_params for direct output. Auth via DASHSCOPE_API_KEY env var (read by translate script's _auth_headers()). Use VLLM_BASE_URL=https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode to target.

qwen36plus-remote.notes: Qwen 3.6 Plus via Dashscope. Thinking model — use enable_thinking=false.

claude-opus.notes: Claude Opus via the Claude Code Agent SDK. Endpoint-less — uses the host's Claude Code subscription auth (no host/port/api key). Thinking on by default. Reserve for the real deliverable run; use claude-sonnet for smoke/test calls.

claude-sonnet.notes: Claude Sonnet via the Claude Code Agent SDK. Endpoint-less (subscription auth). Preferred for smoke/test LLM calls; thinking off by default.

claude-fable.notes: Claude Fable 5 via the Claude Code Agent SDK. Endpoint-less (subscription auth). Used as the GEPA reflective-feedback judge (sparse, capped call budget).

translate_korean_lookup.description: EN->KO procedure translation with Qdrant bilingual pair lookup + style guide

translate_korean_baseline.description: EN->KO baseline translation (no lookup, optional style guide)

score_korean.description: Score translations against KR extension reference (char_sim, token_jaccard, exact)

judge_korean.description: LLM-as-judge: classify non-matching translations as ACCEPTABLE / PARTIAL / WRONG
judge_korean.notes: For Qwen3 reasoning models, disable thinking — otherwise the model burns all tokens on reasoning and returns null content.
